# ADR 0003: Trigram GIN index for fuzzy name search

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** KYB legal entity lookup service

## Context

Users type partial, misspelt and reordered company names.

## Decision

Normalise names and index them with pg_trgm GIN; combine with B-tree filters for country and status.

## Consequences

Sub-100 ms fuzzy search without a search cluster.

## Alternatives considered

Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.
